summary: Ryan Wong, 27, of Fort Collins, found hanging unresponsive from his climbing harness in the South Park area of the Ouray Ice Park around 4 p.m. by other ice climbers; they lowered him and performed CPR with ROSC. Ouray County EMS transported him to Fellin Park, where St. Mary's CareFlight flew him to St. Mary's Hospital in Grand Junction. He was pronounced dead March 1 but kept on life support for organ donation; his body was officially pronounced dead early March 3.
location: Ouray Ice Park, South Park area
responding_agency: Ouray Mountain Rescue Team; Ouray County EMS; Ouray County Sheriff's Office; Ouray Police Department; St. Mary's CareFlight
notes: Joint release dated 2023-03-03 from Ouray County SO, Coroner's Office, City of Ouray, Ouray PD and Ouray Ice Park. Incident ~4 p.m. 2023-02-24. Kept alive artificially 3/1-3/3 to preserve organs: liver + 4 other organs matched to recipients. Cause unwitnessed and unknown.
